mapper.select: SELECT id AS calendar_event_id, title, start_at, end_at, status FROM calendar_events WHERE streamer_id = #{streamerId} AND event_type = 'BROADCAST' AND status = 'SCHEDULED' AND start_at >= #{now} ORDER BY start_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.id AS session_id, s.title, s.ended_at, r.status AS report_status, COALESCE(r.avg_viewers, 0) AS avg_viewers, COALESCE(r.peak_viewers, 0) AS peak_viewers, COALESCE(r.summary, '') AS summary FROM broadcast_sessions s JOIN reports r ON r.session_id = s.id WHERE s.streamer_id = #{streamerId} AND s.status = 'ENDED' ORDER BY s.ended_at DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT count(*) FROM promises WHERE streamer_id = #{streamerId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'ON_HOLD', 'SCHEDULED')

SELECT p.id AS promise_id, p.session_id, p.content, p.status, p.due_date, s.started_at + t.start_ms * interval '1 millisecond' AS detected_at FROM promises p JOIN transcripts t ON t.id = p.transcript_id JOIN broadcast_sessions s ON s.id = p.session_id WHERE p.streamer_id = #{streamerId} AND p.status IN ('PENDING', 'ON_HOLD', 'SCHEDULED') ORDER BY p.due_date ASC NULLS LAST, detected_at DESC, p.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT h.id AS highlight_id, h.end_ms - h.start_ms AS duration_ms, COALESCE(h.clip_url, '') AS clip_url, COALESCE(h.thumbnail_url, '') AS thumbnail_url FROM highlights h JOIN reports r ON r.id = h.report_id JOIN broadcast_sessions s ON s.id = r.session_id WHERE s.streamer_id = #{streamerId} AND r.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIAL') ORDER BY COALESCE(r.generated_at, r.created_at) DESC, h.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
